tests.title: Web POS makes the cheapest eligible item free when buying two and getting one free
tests.goal: Verify that Web POS charges for the two higher-priced units and makes the cheapest eligible unit free only when three eligible units are in the cart.
preconditions: An active buy-two-get-one-free promotion applies to the selected POS store and covers two in-stock products with different prices. Neither product has a competing item-level promotion in that store.
data: Two units of the higher-priced product and one unit of the lower-priced product.

steps.text: Log in to Storeberry with a staff account.
Go to Physical Stores POS and open Web POS for the eligible store.
Add one unit of each eligible product and note their line prices.
Add one more unit of the higher-priced product.
Remove one unit of the higher-priced product.
Clear the test cart without checking out.

expected.text: With two units, neither item is free under this promotion.
With three units, the cheaper unit shows the promotion name and a zero line price; both higher-priced units keep their original unit price.
Returning to two units removes the free-item discount and restores the cheaper unit price.

notes: Storeberry KN: snack01 HKD 100 remained paid with two units. With two HKD 520 Mix Rose units plus snack01, testss made snack01 HKD 0 and the subtotal was HKD 1040. Removing a rose restored snack01 to HKD 100. No sale submitted.
